'''Khaat Qiyn''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="AOTCVD" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Inside" /> who served as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] within the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] by the time of the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]<ref name="CSWE" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}}, which includes the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> She was the master of the [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi apprentice]] [[Bairdon Jace/Legends|Bairdon Jace]].<ref name="SWCTP" /> The Jedi Knight was a student of the [[Form V/Legends|Form V]] technique of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|Lightsaber combat]]<ref name="CSWE" /> and used it to vanquish many opponents.<ref name="Inside" /> Qiyn had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], light skin and wore traditional [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] paired with diplomatic [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="AOTCVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Although her [[Death/Legends|death]] in the First Battle of Geonosis was never officially confirmed, Holocron Keeper [[Leland Chee]], in a [[2005]] [[Star Wars: Blogs]] post, listed her among the Jedi who fought in the battle whose fates were unknown but who likely died.<ref name="Chee">{{Blog|holocron|10|Jedi Casualties: Battle of Geonosis}}</ref> A [[2015]] [[StarWars.com]] article ''Meet the Geonosis Jedi'' by [[Tim Veekhoven]] stated that she likely perished on Geonosis.<ref name="MtGJ">{{SW|url=news/meet-the-geonosis-jedi|text=Meet the Geonosis Jedi}}</ref>
